stem:
Choose the word most nearly opposite in meaning to the word given in capital.

**TRANSIENT**

verdicts.working: “Transient” means temporary or short-lived; its opposite is “permanent.”

working:
Transient means lasting only for a short time. Permanent means lasting indefinitely, so it is the opposite. Brief, fleeting and temporary are synonyms of transient.
